name: CSS Gradient Generator
summary: Build linear, radial, or conic CSS gradients with live preview and copy-ready CSS.
description: Pick gradient type, angle or shape, and color stops with positions. Preview updates live and you can copy a background declaration. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: How are stops ordered?
faqs.answer: Stops are sorted by position (0–100%) when generating CSS.

faqs.question: Is my CSS uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
